claims.text: The Assembly news notice created 3 February 2025 reports that Prime Minister Hon. 'Aisake Eke and his Cabinet Ministers took their oath of office in the Legislative Assembly on Friday 31 January, 'marking the official beginning of their term in Parliament'; that all Ministers, including the Crown Prince as Minister of Foreign Affairs and His Majesty's Armed Forces, took their oaths in Tongan; and that Hon. Paula Piveni Piukala's motion to take his oath in English was lost, 7 in favour and 13 against.
claims.uncertainty: 'Official beginning of their term in Parliament' is the notice's wording and is not read as the start of office.
